note: Preston County WV has no county zoning (county FAQ and economic development pages say so). The largest city, Kingwood, zones its land, but only as a PDF zoning map and ordinance (KingwoodWV-ZoningMap2020.pdf); no queryable GIS service found. Terra Alta, Bruceton Mills and Rowlesburg publish no zoning GIS or map found online. ArcGIS searches for Preston zoning returned only a fire districts layer.
